translation:
(青葙子 (qīngxiāngzǐ) is its envoy; it fears 麥門冬 (màiméndōng); it fears 空青 (kōngqīng), 人參 (rénshēn), and 苦參 (kǔshēn).)

The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 皂莢 (zàojiá), flavor acrid and salty, warm. It governs wind-bi, dead flesh, and evil-qi (風痹死肌邪氣), wind-head with tearing eyes (風頭淚出), benefits the nine orifices (利九竅), and kills...
